scope: A finite synthetic inference-control extension for R05. Four distinct output latents receive state-dependent neural refinement allocations; the semantic condition q remains fixed. No new weight training, natural-data model, general FBSDE solution or production NeuronRuntime integration is claimed.
preservation: All v1/v1.1/v2/v3 scientific source, protocols, results and failures remain unchanged. New implementation and evidence belong to v4.

source_policy.checkpoint_loading: CPU weights_only=True followed by strict tensor-state loading and exact checkpoint hash verification; no unsafe fallback
source_policy.learned_operations: Reuse the v3 learned conditional gain MLP, initial map, actual source encoder and all four trained decoder modules. Sharing gain weights across modalities does not share their mutable latent states.
source_policy.training_claim: Prior v2/v3 checkpoint training is historical evidence. This v4 study isolates allocation policy effects with identical fixed weights; it does not demonstrate new allocation-aware end-to-end training or its global optimum.

development.permitted_changes: Implementation fixes only. Scientific changes require a dated amendment before new confirmation and preservation of prior attempts. No favorable-result stopping or post-confirmation threshold changes.

conditioning.raw_input: Fresh clean synthetic text rendered by the existing world contract; its last-token nuisance is generated independently of innovations.
conditioning.raw_input_call: world._render_modality(numpy.array([condition_index], dtype=numpy.int64), 'text', registered_render_generator, nuisance=True). This generates only the observed text; world.render does not accept a Generator and must not replace this call by silently changing the RNG stream.
conditioning.q_definition: One-hot argmax of the actually executed frozen text encoder. q is an eight-class semantic condition, never a four-modality allocation vector.
conditioning.encoder_contract_check: Exhaustively check the existing 16 clean text inputs, two nuisance alternatives for each class. A misclassification fails the declared clean-condition contract; do not relabel evaluator truth or silently substitute the requested class for the encoder report.
conditioning.canonical_data: The existing eight synthetic training prototypes are available to offline planning and to a separate post-emission evaluator. Live policy selection receives no prototype, evaluator truth, scenario label or future innovation.

generator.anchor: a(q) = frozen initial_latent(q), executed once per trajectory
generator.state: Fixed q; four separate current z_m; last-update residuals; global refinement count t; remaining budget; causal action history; state version and emission seal.
generator.initial_state: z_m = a(q) + initial_coefficient(mode,m) * initial_direction(seed,m). All four initial disturbances are mandatory in the constrained arms.
generator.refine_m: Only z_m changes: z_m' = a(q) + (1 - sigmoid(MLP(q,z_m-a(q)))) * (z_m-a(q)) + innovation(seed,global_refinement_index,m). The other three latents are unchanged.
generator.per_modality_refinement_limit: Only the total limit applies; refining the same modality twice is feasible.
generator.feedback: Observe all four actual current latents, residual RMS and last-update RMS, global depth and remaining budget. Residuals use the explicitly known clean source-conditioned anchor, not a learned correctness estimator.
generator.emit: STOP executes decoder_m(z_m) for each of text/audio/image/video exactly once as a complete terminal bundle, then seals the stream. No output may be omitted or revised after emission.
generator.causal_revelation: Choose and commit REFINE_m before obtaining that step's fresh innovation. The policy has no access to the sampler object, world RNG keys or unrevealed branches.

disturbance_design.initial_coefficient_rule: For modality index m and mode j, use initial_coefficient_base[(m-j) mod 4]. Mode IDs are not provided to the live controller; the initial state is observed through its four latents.
disturbance_design.direction_algorithm: For each registered integer direction_seed, draw 64 float64 standard normals with numpy.random.default_rng(direction_seed), multiply by 0.8/sqrt(mean(direction**2)), then cast to float32. Directions are public fixed support, independent of model outcomes and semantic class.
disturbance_design.global_refinement_index: 1 for the first refinement, 2 for the second; it is the global count, not a modality-local count.
disturbance_design.future_draws: Independent over world, global refinement index and modality under the registered keyed sampler; realized only after a selected action commits.
disturbance_design.order_dependence: Changing modality order can change which global-index innovation bank reaches each latent. Therefore fixed plans must enumerate all ordered sequences, not only allocation-count vectors.
disturbance_design.benchmark_limitation: The four initial patterns and three-branch future support are artificial and known. A clean-anchor decoder bypass is available outside the mandatory-disturbance contract. This is not evidence that natural generation requires these disturbances.

resource_contract.budget_unit: Actually executed dense nn.Linear MACs per trajectory; one multiplication/addition pair is one MAC. This is a counted operation budget, not measured total FLOPs, latency, energy or memory.
resource_contract.budget_identity: 351232 = 3584 + 2*8704 + 330240. INIT charges the actually executed encoder and anchor once. Python and native ledgers represent the same cost; encoder must not be added again outside the native total.
resource_contract.reserve_rule: A refinement is feasible only if remaining budget covers its actual Linear MACs plus all four final decoders; total refinement horizon must also remain feasible.
resource_contract.per_modality_allocation_receipt: Report executed refine counts and refine_macs[m]*count[m] + decoder_macs[m] for each modality. The 3584 common input/anchor MACs remain shared overhead.
resource_contract.independent_count_check: Actual nn.Linear invocation/shape hooks must agree with operation receipts and both ledgers. Refine_m invokes one gain MLP and changes only its selected state; all four decoder hooks must fire on emission.
not_in_linear_mac_budget: offline tree construction and policy compilation
additional_measurements: all actual offline neural forward examples and MACs
resource_contract.all_search_cost_rule: Offline planning is a separately reported nonzero cost. Publish standalone planning cost and actual shared-cache accounting plus total experiment cost; report amortization at N=1 and N=1024. Do not call an online-MAC gain an end-to-end speed or energy gain.

objective.terminal_global_loss: Unchanged external metric: mean across four modalities of normalized true-prototype MSE clipped at 2, plus 0.25 times the fraction of the six nearest-class modality pairs that disagree.
objective.planning_semantics: In this clean fixed-condition restoration study, offline terminal loss is against the known encoded condition. Confirmation evaluation uses the original rendered class only after actual complete emission. Encoder-contract failures are not repaired by changing labels.
objective.certainty_equivalent: CE_gamma(X|state) = -log(E[exp(-gamma*X)|state])/gamma; gamma=0 uses the expectation. Stable finite-support implementation with probability checks is required.
objective.bellman: At a feasible post-INIT state s, STOP has value -L(s)-lambda*330240. REFINE_m has value -lambda*8704 + CE_gamma(V(next_state)|s,m). Choose the largest feasible value. At depth 2 only STOP is feasible. Subtract lambda*3584 once at the initial root.
objective.no_double_penalty: The budget subtracts resources; the value separately prices them. Each executed action contributes its utility cost exactly once. Future refinements and final emission are already included in the child continuation value.
objective.reported_global_J: For each fixed checkpoint seed and each of its 32 observed (q,initial_mode) roots, compute the conditional CE over future innovations of R, then average the 32 conditional CEs equally. The overall J averages the three checkpoint-specific values equally. This is not one CE over a mixture of initial modes or checkpoints.
objective.mathematical_scope: Finite-horizon nominal risk-sensitive control with a known transition law. It is not a new proof of general Neural Differential Utility dynamics, preference identification or a nonlinear FBSDE solver.

policies.dynamic: Re-evaluate STOP and all four feasible REFINE_m actions after every new observed state using the two-step entropic Bellman continuation values.
policies.initial_feedback_committed_open_loop: For each fully observed initial four-latent state, exactly evaluate all 21 ordered modality sequences of lengths 0, 1 or 2, allowing repetition. Select the best plan under the identical conditional CE, terminal global loss and actual costs. Commit before future innovations, execute its predetermined sequence, then emit; future feedback cannot change its length or modality order.
policies.open_loop_plan_order: Length 0 first, then lengths 1 and 2 in lexicographic modality order text,audio,image,video. The empty sequence emits immediately.
policies.myopic: At each actual state, compare STOP with each feasible one-refinement-then-STOP conditional CE minus that refinement cost. Choose with the common tie rule, execute, observe, and repeat while feasible. Its realized full-policy CE is evaluated separately from its one-step decision score.
policies.clean_no_disturbance_reference: Execute the same source encoder and anchor, initialize all z_m=a(q) without disturbances, then emit all four learned outputs. This diagnostic violates the mandatory-disturbance condition by construction and is outside the constrained dynamic-policy optimum.
policies.comparison_rule: Scan feasible candidates in the frozen order. Replace the current selection only when candidate_value > selected_value + 1e-12. Apply the identical rule to dynamic actions, myopic actions and the 21 ordered fixed plans.
policies.numerical_optimality_scope: This deterministic tolerance gives an epsilon-optimal choice, not an infinite-precision exact maximum. Check per-state max-score gap <=1e-12 and independent two-step value agreement within 1e-10; the two decision layers can propagate at most 2e-12 from these action ties.
policies.finite_support_claim: The compiled dynamic policy weakly dominates the included fixed and myopic policies under the same registered finite model up to numerical tolerance. That policy-class fact alone is not independent evidence of a scientific or scalable-compute advantage.

planning.anchor_reuse: The eight q-conditioned anchors may be computed once and reused for the four declared initial modes during offline compilation. Online each trajectory pays its own encoder and anchor.
planning.estimate_exclusions: Encoder contract audit, rendering, bookkeeping and controller arithmetic are not included in this tree-only estimate and must be separately accounted.
planning.cache_policy: Exact reuse of previously executed identical neural intermediates is allowed and must be metered. Synthetic output rendering may never replace a decoder. Save the loss/transition tables required for independent full enumeration and bind them to model and protocol hashes.
planning.live_lookup: Bind live observed q/depth/four latents and causal history to the frozen compiled support with maximum absolute latent tolerance 2e-5. No evaluator truth, initial mode ID, hidden future branch or validation outcome may choose the node. Ambiguous matches with different action values beyond the numerical tolerance fail explicitly.

confirmation.innovation_rng: After committing REFINE_m at global refinement index t, construct numpy.random.default_rng(numpy.random.SeedSequence([5200000,study_seed,world_id,t,m])) and draw exactly one branch with probabilities [0.25,0.5,0.25].
confirmation.paired_common_random_numbers: All arms use the same potential innovation key for a common (seed,world,t,m), but only the selected action's sample is revealed after commitment. Other potential samples are neither eagerly supplied to the policy nor reported in its input.
confirmation.heldout_meaning: Fresh raw nuisance and stochastic branch draws on the declared finite support. The eight semantics, four initial patterns and possible future branches have already been enumerated during planning. This is execution confirmation, not unseen-class, unseen-support or natural-data generalization.
confirmation.evaluation_order: Run all registered seeds and all arms. Score saved actual outputs after emission. Preserve every failed attempt; do not stop after favorable results.
confirmation.native_execution: A new independent native modality-action budget bridge must select among the five complete candidate scores, enforce the full budget/horizon and the INIT-bound policy mode/committed plan, and require actual state/output acknowledgments. It is a research bridge, not production NeuronRuntime dispatch.
confirmation.native_init_cost: Native INIT charges 3584 for the actually executed text encoder plus anchor. Python reconciles that same cost and must not add the encoder a second time.
confirmation.native_feedback_ack: After REFINE_m, acknowledge all four ordered actual latent hashes. The three unselected hashes must be unchanged; the selected hash may be unchanged on a legitimate zero update. Until acknowledgment, another choice is forbidden. STOP acknowledges four emitted output hashes and seals the stream.

native_contract.wire_format: One TSV line per command or response, prefix MP1; no production NeuronRuntime dispatch is modified.
native_contract.stop_mapping: The mathematical/planner action STOP is the wire action EMIT.
native_contract.init_fields: INIT sid q_index q_sha256 budget init_cost H decode_cost[4] refine_cost[4] latent_hash[4] policy_mode plan
native_contract.choose_fields: CHOOSE sid version joint_latent_sha256 (action value cost)[5]
native_contract.emitted_fields: EMITTED sid version joint_latent_sha256 text output_hash audio output_hash image output_hash video output_hash
native_contract.fixed_profile_enforced: Reject any INIT profile other than budget351232, init3584, H2, decoder costs[6656,69632,53248,200704] and refinement costs[8704,8704,8704,8704].
native_contract.plan_encoding: ADAPTIVE and CLEAN require '-'. COMMITTED uses '-' for zero steps, one REFINE_action token for one step, or two comma-separated REFINE_action tokens for two steps, for example REFINE_text,REFINE_audio. Only the four registered REFINE tokens are allowed; repetitions are legal.
native_contract.policy_eligibility: ADAPTIVE permits all budget/horizon-feasible actions. COMMITTED binds its full preselected plan at INIT, permits only the next prescribed refinement until that plan is exhausted, then permits only EMIT. CLEAN permits only EMIT. Native independently enforces these restrictions; a caller cannot revise the plan after observing a new innovation.
native_contract.complete_candidate_table: Every CHOOSE supplies exactly the five finite-valued candidates and their registered costs. Native normalizes their order, independently masks budget/horizon/policy-ineligible actions, and applies the common comparison rule. All eligible scores must be genuine values under the arm's declared rule: Bellman action values for dynamic, one-step-then-STOP scores for myopic, remaining committed-plan conditional utility for COMMITTED, and terminal emission utility for CLEAN. Priority encodings such as selected=0 and others=-1 are forbidden.
native_contract.ineligible_score_convention: Every budget/horizon/policy-ineligible action, including EMIT when a committed plan is unfinished, has the finite placeholder score 0 and its normal registered resource cost. That score carries no feasible future-value meaning and must be masked. In particular all four refinement slots remain present at H2. Native rejects a nonzero placeholder for an ineligible action.
native_contract.latent_joint_hash: SHA256 of UTF-8 domain hepta.modality-portfolio.latents.v1 followed by one NUL byte, followed by the four raw 32-byte latent digests in modality order.
native_contract.output_joint_hash: SHA256 of UTF-8 domain hepta.modality-portfolio.outputs.v1 followed by one NUL byte, followed by the four raw 32-byte output digests in modality order.
native_contract.successful_choice_transition: Charge the chosen cost once, increment version, increment only the chosen modality's refinement count when applicable, and enter await_refinement or await_outputs. Do not allow another CHOOSE before the matching actual-neural acknowledgment.
native_contract.acknowledgment_rule: REFINED may change only the selected latent digest and leaves all three other digests fixed; an unchanged selected digest is allowed. EMITTED verifies the current joint latent digest and four ordered output digests, then seals the session.
native_contract.ok_response_fields: MP1 OK CMD sid version remaining total_refinements n_text n_audio n_image n_video phase joint_hash; CHOOSE appends action value; EMITTED appends ordered named output hashes and output_joint_hash.
native_contract.failure_contract: Any invalid command leaves the state atomically unchanged. EOF with an unfinished session is a failure.

mechanism_acceptance.purpose: Close only the narrow implemented-and-executed R05 modality-allocation mechanism. No superiority result is required for this mechanism gate.
mechanism_acceptance.all_four_refine_actions_physically_teste: Development contract tests must execute each REFINE_m and independently check only that latent changed or legitimately stayed equal, only its selected refinement work was charged, and all four actual decoders later emitted.
mechanism_acceptance.strong_state_dependent_modality_gate: For each of the three registered source seeds, find at least one pair of positive-probability sibling branches with identical q, initial four-latent state, first REFINE_m action and remaining budget, but different first innovations, such that the second decision is REFINE_a in one branch and REFINE_b in the other with a != b. Both branches and second actions must actually occur in the registered confirmation worlds with executed neural updates and native acknowledgments.
mechanism_acceptance.stop_difference_not_sufficient: A second-step STOP-versus-REFINE difference alone does not satisfy the strong modality-reallocation gate. Report it separately.
mechanism_acceptance.independent_oracle: For every compiled root, independently enumerate all 21 fixed plans and all future branch paths, then independently perform the two-step Bellman recursion. Recompute leaf CE(-external_loss - total_priced_cost), numerical tie behavior, actions, plan identity and budget ledgers. Primary evaluator uses saved actual four-output tensors. Native plan binding and actual executed modality sequences must equal the preselected open-loop plan.
mechanism_acceptance.action_value_audit_scope: The 1e-10 tolerance compares independent Bellman/21-plan arithmetic given exactly the same saved terminal loss table; it is not imposed on independent neural floating-point replay.
mechanism_acceptance.numerical_audit_layers: Independently replay learned neural arithmetic within maximum absolute 2e-5. Independently recompute the external loss from the saved actual outputs in float64 within 1e-10. Compare Bellman and fixed-plan solvers on identical saved loss data within 1e-10; report these three checks separately.
mechanism_acceptance.negative_result_rule: If the strong state-dependent modality gate fails, report that action-space/runtime implementation exists but the preregistered executed-allocation mechanism gate did not close. Do not tune noise, thresholds, weights or initial patterns after inspecting confirmation.

performance_analysis.primary_contrast: J_dynamic - J_initial_feedback_committed_open_loop under the identical conditional-CE definition above
performance_analysis.primary_superiority_hypothesis: Superiority in this finite benchmark is reported only if the paired stratified bootstrap 95 percent lower bound for the primary contrast is strictly greater than zero. Mechanism closure remains a separate gate.
performance_analysis.exact_model_values: Publish exact finite-support conditional values and their equal-weight aggregates alongside Monte Carlo execution estimates; distinguish deterministic policy-class dominance from sampled execution evidence.
performance_analysis.secondary_contrast: J_dynamic - J_myopic, descriptive and unadjusted; a result against a weaker global fixed allocation cannot replace the 21-plan primary contrast.
other_reported_metrics: external mean loss and paired differences
per-modality refinement counts and allocated MACs
mean and total online Linear MACs
strong sibling witnesses and their observed frequencies
performance_analysis.bootstrap_method: Within every fixed (source_seed,q,initial_mode) stratum, resample its 32 world indices with replacement, paired across arms. Recompute each conditional CE from the sampled returns, average the 32 strata equally within each seed, and average the three fixed seeds equally. Do not resample checkpoints.
performance_analysis.inference_scope: Approximate Monte Carlo intervals conditional on these three frozen checkpoints and the registered finite stochastic support. They do not establish a population claim over training seeds or a generalization guarantee.
performance_analysis.end_to_end_efficiency_claim: Any claim beyond the dense-Linear online budget requires the separately measured full search/controller/native/model costs. No such gain is presumed.

evidence_rules: Commit this scientific protocol before v4 development and confirmation; record the actual preregistration commit externally rather than inventing it in this file.
Freeze implementation and source hashes before registered confirmation; preserve all failures and amendments.
Hash input checkpoints, innovation banks, protocol, compiled values, actual latents, outputs and receipts.
Retain actual neural-call and native transcripts sufficient for independent causal, allocation, budget and output replay.
Disclose fixed support, known anchor, inherited weights, complete search and lack of new training.
Do not reinterpret semantic q weights as modality resources, omit required outputs, or use test labels to choose live actions.
A finite Bellman optimum and an executed allocation mechanism are separate from evidence of performance superiority and from a global neural-training optimum.
